fieldValues.title: Every instance file's own instanceId is its identity; there is no…
fieldValues.normative_statement: Every instance file discovered under a reserved instance root MUST declare an `instanceId`, and that self-declared value is the instance's identity. There is no manifest index entry to cross-check it against — `RepositoryManifest.instanceIndex` is retired (RFC-038 [R2]) and the repository's authoritative store, enumerated from the tree, is the instance set (RFC-038 [R1]).
